definitions.explanation: The personal belongings a person leaves behind when they die, such as clothes, letters and keepsakes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺品|いひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧。
examples.english: I sort through my father's belongings.

examples.japanese: {遺品|いひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Among the things he left was an old letter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺品|いひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕立|した}て{直|なお}して→仕立て直す：21949_shitatenaosu⟧⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|き}せた→着せる：13684_kiseru⟧。
examples.english: I had my grandmother's kimono remade and put it on my daughter.

notes:
Refers to a dead person's things in general. {遺品|いひん}⟦{整理|せいり}→整理：03297_seiri⟧ (sorting out a deceased person's belongings) is now also the name of a professional service.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遺品|いひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧: to sort out the belongings of the deceased
- {遺品|いひん}⟦{整理|せいり}→整理：03297_seiri⟧: estate clean-out (also a business)
- ⟦{故人|こじん}→故人：02807_kojin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺品|いひん}: the belongings of the deceased

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{形見|かたみ}→形見：12505_katami⟧: keepsake, memento — an item kept to remember the person, often given to someone
- ⟦{遺産|いさん}→遺産：14405_isan⟧: inheritance, estate — property with monetary value
